The V:EKN Rules recommend 30 minutes for deck construction and registration.
[VEKN 3.1.1] [VEKN 7.5.3]

Drafting time (for a new release) should take about 10 minutes per pack (plus
the time it takes to distribute the packs and give the players the instructions
for the draft procedure).

So if you've got 3 packs per player, it should take about 30 minutes to draft,
not counting the overhead mentioned above.
(That's for booster draft - table draft might take slightly longer).
